Hi Tessa,

We're in the process of adding Redwood Inference to Olson Financials' supplier master so AP can route payments and match invoices to POs. A couple of quick asks to get the portal record created: 

- Do you have a preferred remit address for invoices? (postal + billing contact)
- Please confirm the tax status for UK/EU sales (VAT number or W8/W9 as applicable).
- Our portal requires: company registration name, VAT/Tax ID, bank details (IBAN/SWIFT), and a copy of vendor onboarding docs (W-forms or VAT cert).
- PO matching rules: our AP requires the PO number in the invoice header and the PO must reference the same line-level quantities. We also accept a one-line header match if you include PO number and order total.

We've opened a registration ticket for you: https://vendor.olsonfin.co.uk/portal/registration/redirect?ref=REDWOOD-1234 — once you complete the portal form, it will generate a vendor ID and allow PO acceptance.

Can you complete the portal or send the onboarding packet to me and I can upload on your behalf? We also sometimes need a signed vendor form (we can DocuSign it).

Thanks,
Emily

Thanks Tessa — couple quick follow-ups after reviewing your packet: 

- Portal registration: either option is fine; we can create the vendor record after you submit the portal form, or I can upload the packet if you prefer. The form asks for a VAT number field — if you don't have a VAT number we mark the supplier as "non-VAT registered" and the system will route invoices for manual VAT treatment (we typically apply reverse-charge where applicable).
- Currency / invoicing: will you be issuing invoices in USD or GBP? Our POs will be in GBP for UK entities — if invoices are USD we need a conversion reference on the invoice and prefer you to include a suggested GBP amount for PO matching.
- PO matching: we can accept header-only PO numbers for services. For goods we require line-level match. Your note about tolerance is helpful — our system allows +/- 0.50 GBP line-level tolerance.

If you can upload the completed portal form, that will help speed things up. Otherwise I can upload the packet and create the vendor ID, after which I'll send the DocuSign link for the standard supplier agreement.

Thanks,
Emily
